item.title: Trump deletes racist video on Obamas after row, but refuses to apologise
item.description: The nearly one-minute video showed Obamas as monkeys for around a second. It was deleted later by the White House following a controversy.

item.title: ASEAN Connect: How PM Modi's Malaysia visit reinforces India's Act East Policy
item.description: India’s Act East Policy is a diplomatic and strategic initiative aimed at strengthening India’s ties with the countries of Southeast Asia, East Asia, and the Asia-Pacific region. It is essentially an evolution of the earlier Look East Policy, which was adopted by the then PM PV Narasimha Rao .

item.title: Ghooskhor Pandat controversy: FWICE warns Manoj Bajpayee film's makers over title dispute
item.description: Manoj Bajpayee's film, titled Ghooskhor Pandat recently sparked a major controversy. The Federation of Western India Cine Employees (FWICE) has also raised objections regarding the film's title.

item.title: Odisha to establish Sovereign AI Park, signs key MoU with Sarvam
item.description: The Odisha government has said that this initiative, signed in presence of President Murmu on Friday, will position the state as India’s leading provider of sovereign AI and compute capacity.

item.title: BJP set to end 40-year drought at BMC; Ritu Tawde to secure mayor’s post, Sena’s Ghadi her deputy
item.description: Ritu Tawde has been elected as a corporator from Ghatkopar for the third consecutive term. Despite belonging to the Maratha community, she has managed to secure victory from a ward dominated by Gujarati voters.

item.title: AI creating more jobs than it replaces, says RBI Deputy Governor
item.description: RBI says AI will create more jobs than it replaces, though workforce transition remains a challenge. Meanwhile, banking customers will get up to Rs 25,000 compensation for digital fraud, funded through the DEA Fund.

item.title: Why is Fakhar Zaman not playing in PAK vs NED T20 World Cup 2026 match? Explained
item.description: Fakhar Zaman misses out as Pakistan face the Netherlands in the first match of the T20 World Cup 2026. Fakhar is known as a destructive batter; however, he was not picked for Pakistan's tournament opener in Colombo.

item.title: Safe harbour does not exempt X from Sahyog portal, says Delhi High Court
item.description: The Delhi High Court ruled that safe harbour protection does not allow X to refuse joining the Sahyog portal, citing the need for quicker information sharing in criminal probes and noting delays faced by police.

item.title: Meet Ritu Tawde: BJP leader poised to take charge as BMC mayor
item.description: BMC mayoral elections 2026: BJP corporator Ritu Tawde is set to become the next mayor of Mumbai. She represents the ward number 132 in India's financial capital.

item.title: Rose Day 2026 Special: When Dilip Kumar and Madhubala's love story began with a rose and letter
item.description: It's February and with it, the Valentine's Week is here. On the occasion of rose day, we are sharing an interesting anecdote related to Dilip Kumar and Madhubala.
